name: Prison-tug
description: A prison-tug, also referred to as a tug cruiser was a type of modified Arquitens-class command cruiser utilized by the Galactic Empire as a tug for wreckage-prisons. One such prison-tug hauled Accresker Jail, which was in operation during the Galactic Civil War until a Gundravian hookspore infestation forced the evacuation of the jail.
